_comment: Curated UK duty overlays, applied automatically by build_duty_rates.py on EVERY revision build. The dataset itself carries per-code VAT measures (type 305, incl. reduced/zero rates) which surface as informational rows; this flat_taxes entry is the headline reminder that import VAT applies on top of duty.

flat_taxes.name: VAT — Value Added Tax (standard rate, on the duty-inclusive value)
flat_taxes.applies_note: Standard rate; some goods are reduced-rated (5%) or zero-rated — the per-code VAT rows below reflect the dataset's own VAT measures.
